_about: What the Play app's Daily, City, Draw, Party and Boards tabs show (all-day/js/modes/play-*.js). Hand-edited. Links are the live arcade's; a thing with "soon" set has no working link yet and its button says Coming soon. Written Oct 29, 2026.

daily.name: Btown Wordle
daily.line: A Burlington word puzzle, fresh every day.

daily.name: Crossings
daily.line: Word tiles: Church Street doubles your word, the Waterfront triples a letter.

daily.name: The News Quiz
daily.line: Five questions from this week’s Brief. One minute.

daily.name: Higher or Lower
daily.line: One Burlington number, then another. Higher or lower?

daily.name: Where in Btown
daily.line: One local photo, one guess: name the spot.

daily.name: Real or Fake
daily.line: A real Burlington headline, or one we made up?

streets.name: Every Street
streets.line: Burlington has 1,191 blocks of named street. They all start dark; walk one end to end and it turns gold for good.
streets.honest: Built and working, but it runs only on a local copy today. It isn’t on the arcade yet, so there’s nothing to open.

lit.name: Keep Burlington Lit
lit.line: Thirty-five portals around town. Stand at one, type the code word from its card, and it lights. The whole town tries to keep 80% lit through the season.
lit.honest: Unlisted: it isn’t in the arcade’s list yet, but the link works.

dibs.name: Dibs
dibs.line: Burlington cut into 920 blocks. Stand in one, tap, it’s yours until someone takes it back.

photos.name: Photo quests
photos.line: Coming here: quests you finish with a photo. Find the mural, visit a business you’ve never walked into, clean up a block.

now.name: Btown Hunt
now.line: Walk-and-collect packs with one passport, live now.

crews.name: Crews
crews.line: Coming here: neighborhood crews, so the streets, blocks and quests you claim count for the Old North End or the South End, with a board for each.

season.name: Season
season.line: Coming here: a season of the city game, with collections that change with the weather and sponsored quests from local places.

lake.title: The Lake
lake.line: Draw a fish with your finger, sign it or don’t, and release it. It swims in a shared Lake Champlain with everyone else’s, and the lake is never empty: fifteen house fish live there from day one. Tap any fish to see who drew it. Champ glides past now and then.

truck.title: The Truck
truck.line: Draw a wheel, and the game rolls the shape you actually drew: round is smooth, a square clunks. Drive Church Street’s bricks, the plow pile, North Ave’s potholes and the Winooski bridge. Distance goes on the arcade’s monthly board.

more.title: Gallery
more.line: Everything people drew, newest first. Drive anyone’s truck from it.

more.title: Prompt of the week
more.line: One thing to draw each week. Most likes by Sunday wins, and the winner goes up on the truck’s billboard.

party.name: Btown Party
party.when: A room of 10 to 60 at a mixer
party.line: Everyone scans one code and answers a few tiny questions; the payoff lands on a shared screen. Phones go back in pockets.

party.name: Church Street Trivia
party.line: Bar trivia where every table’s phone is the buzzer, so the back of a loud room can play. The host runs it from a laptop on the TV.

party.name: Arcade Night
party.when: Game night on a big screen
party.line: Pick tonight’s games, put the scoreboard on the TV. People play on their own phones and their best scores land on the wall.

party.name: Stay Awhile
party.when: A table of people you just met
party.line: Three questions, ask them out loud, find out who you’re sitting with. One button deals three more.

party.name: Table Talk
party.when: A dinner table or a meetup
party.line: Prop a phone on the table: icebreakers, weekend picks, friendly local debates, one big card at a time. Sync puts every phone on the same card.

predictions.name: Predictions
predictions.line: Coming here: the Predictions League. First up is First Snow 2026: guess the day Burlington gets its first measurable snow, with the inches as a tiebreaker. Then the lake freezing over and the first 80° day.
predictions.honest: The First Snow page is built and staged but not merged or live yet.

bracket.name: Btown Bracket
bracket.line: Readers nominate, readers vote: sixteen go in, one comes out. A season at a time.
